verses.text: I love the LORD, because he hears my voice and my cry for mercy.
Because he turned his ear to me, I will call to him as long as I live.
The ropes of death were wrapped around me. The pains of the grave took hold of me. I was overcome by trouble and sorrow.
Then I called on the name of the LORD: "LORD, please save my life!"
The LORD is kind and does what is right. Our God is full of mercy.
The LORD protects simple people. When I was brought low, he saved me.
Be at rest again, my soul, because the LORD has been good to you.
You have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from tripping.
I will walk with the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, so I said, "I am suffering terribly."
In my panic I said, "Everyone is a liar."
What can I give back to the LORD for all the good things he has done for me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
I will keep my promises to the LORD in front of all his people.
The death of his faithful people is precious in the LORD's eyes.
LORD, I truly am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have set me free from my chains.
I will offer you a sacrifice of thanks and call on the name of the LORD.
I will keep my promises to the LORD in front of all his people,
in the courtyards of the LORD's house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
